source_id: OA-UC-51 Main Flow - Request Graduate Seminar
purpose: Verify main success flow of OA-UC-51 where an eligible PG student successfully submits a graduate seminar request.
preconditions: Postgraduate student (M.Tech) is logged in with valid session.
action_or_input: Student submits seminar request with topic='Distributed Consensus in Fusion ERP', abstract='Analysis of Raft and Paxos...', discipline='CSE', preferred_date='future date'.
expected_result: Request record is created with status AWAITING_SCHEDULING; confirmation returned to student.

source_id: OA-UC-51 Alternative A1 - Non-PG Student Ineligibility
purpose: Verify alternative exception flow of OA-UC-51 where an ineligible non-postgraduate student attempts to request a seminar.
preconditions: Student enrolled in undergraduate B.Tech programme is logged in.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit a seminar scheduling request.
expected_result: System refuses request with validation error stating postgraduate standing is required; no request is stored.

source_id: OA-UC-51 Alternative A2 - Missing Required Fields
purpose: Verify validation exception flow of OA-UC-51 when mandatory fields such as topic or abstract are omitted.
preconditions: Eligible PG student is logged in.
action_or_input: Student submits request with empty topic and abstract.
expected_result: System returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with field validation errors; request is not created.

source_id: OA-UC-53 Main Flow - Schedule Graduate Seminar
purpose: Verify main success flow of OA-UC-53 where Department Administrator schedules an awaiting seminar request.
preconditions: A seminar request in AWAITING_SCHEDULING status exists. Department Administrator is logged in.
action_or_input: Administrator provides scheduled_date, start_time='10:00:00', end_time='11:30:00', venue='Seminar Hall A', session_chair='Prof. A. Kumar', remarks='Approved by DRC'.
expected_result: GraduateSeminar record is generated, request status transitions to SCHEDULED, and audit history log is recorded.

source_id: OA-UC-53 Alternative A1 - Reject Seminar Request
purpose: Verify alternative flow of OA-UC-53 where Department Administrator rejects a pending seminar request with justification remarks.
preconditions: A seminar request in AWAITING_SCHEDULING status exists. Department Administrator is logged in.
action_or_input: Administrator submits rejection action with remarks='Topic requires further research proposal approval'.
expected_result: Request status transitions to REJECTED with rejection remarks saved; no GraduateSeminar is scheduled.

source_id: OA-UC-53 Alternative A2 - Non-Admin Unauthorized Scheduling Attempt
purpose: Verify security exception flow of OA-UC-53 where a non-administrator attempts to schedule a seminar.
preconditions: Standard student or faculty member without scheduling authority is logged in.
action_or_input: User attempts POST to schedule endpoint for a pending request.
expected_result: Action is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden; request status remains unchanged.

source_id: OA-UC-54 Main Flow - View Seminar Schedule
purpose: Verify main success flow of OA-UC-54 where campus users view public schedule of confirmed graduate seminars.
preconditions: Confirmed scheduled seminars exist in the system.
expected_result: System returns list of scheduled seminars showing speaker name, date, time, venue, and title.

source_id: OA-UC-41 Main Flow - Record Thesis Supervisor Allocation
purpose: Verify main success flow of OA-UC-41 where Department Administrator records research supervisor allocation for PG scholar.
preconditions: Department Administrator is logged in. Research scholar exists in department.
action_or_input: Administrator submits supervisor allocation: student_id, student_name, supervisor_id, supervisor_name, thesis_topic='Quantum Computing'.
expected_result: Supervisor allocation record is created in ACTIVE status with confirmation message.

source_id: OA-UC-42 Main Flow - Record TA Allocation
purpose: Verify main success flow of OA-UC-42 where Department Administrator records teaching assistant assignment.
preconditions: Department Administrator is logged in. PG student eligible for assistantship exists.
action_or_input: Administrator submits TA allocation: student_id, course_code='CS202', course_name='Data Structures', faculty_id=102, hours_per_week=10.
expected_result: TA allocation record is created with HTTP 201 Created.
